title: verdict.lock — pinned repo lens packs
description: The pin file at .verdict/verdict.lock: strict JSON with exactly one row per pack vendored under .verdict/packs/, sorted by name. Every row locks a repo-layer pack, including the one a base-owned packs.org_pack pin vendors — the built-in pack is pinned by the binary and per-operator settings packs live outside the lock. source is dir:<path as given> or git:<allowlisted url>@<40-hex sha>; hash is the pack's canonical tree hash; sig is sha256 over the row's name, source, version, and hash, plus org_path and org_ref on an org row, so a hand edit is caught. A row synced from a pin also records org_path (the central path it came from) and org_ref (the immutable ref the pin named): moving either without re-running pack sync refuses pack-lock-missing. fetch, post, and record refuse pack-lock-missing or pack-lock-drift from the trusted-base snapshot, and the file joins the controls inventory so an edited snapshot copy refuses controls-stale.

packs.description: One pinned pack row per vendored repo pack, sorted by name.

pack.description: One pinned pack: its manifest identity, where it was vendored from, the canonical tree hash, and an integrity digest over those fields.

name.description: Manifest pack identity as <namespace>/<slug>; the vendored directory is the slug.

source.description: dir:<path as given on the add command line> or git:<url>@<resolved 40-hex HEAD sha>. A dir: payload is a slash path with no control character, backslash, or leading "-". A git: URL is exactly https://host/path with no userinfo, ssh://user@host/path, or user@host:path, with a DNS, IPv4, or bracketed IPv6 host, a path with no control character, whitespace, "?", "#", or leading "-", and only the bare [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64} ssh user; the scheme is stored lower-case, so an upper-case row refuses.

version.description: Pinned pack semver, as the manifest declares it.

hash.description: The pack's canonical tree hash: sha256 over sorted slash paths, each fed as `== <path-length>:<path> ==`, the body's byte length, the body's bytes, then a newline.

sig.description: sha256 over the entry's `name=`, `source=`, `version=`, and `hash=` lines in that order, then `org_path=` and `org_ref=` when the row records them. A row with neither org field hashes exactly as it did before those fields existed. Integrity only: a hand edit breaks it; it is not a signature.

org_path.description: The central-repository path an org pack was synced from, recorded only on the row a base-owned packs.org_pack pin vendored. It is a slash path confined to that repository — the repository root records no org_path — and a lock row whose path no longer matches the pin refuses until pack sync re-vendors it. Absent on every row that came from pack add.

org_ref.description: The immutable ref an org pack was synced at: the 40-hex commit or semver tag the base pin named at sync time. It is what makes a tag bump detectable — the recorded commit hash alone would keep matching — so bumping v1.0.0 to v1.1.0 without re-running pack sync refuses pack-lock-missing. Absent on every row that came from pack add.
